title: Noetherian strict base and closed-point chart contraction
statement: Let W be a locally Noetherian fs log scheme, R a commutative monoid, Q an fs monoid, y:W -> Spec Z[R], and h:R -> Q. At a geometric point z of the toric pullback use the canonical A, baseMap and alpha defined by def-trf-formal-chart-geometric-data. Suppose zA is a lift of z to Spec A times_W Z over the canonical closed geometric point of Spec A. Let eC:Spec(A tensor_Z[R] Z[Q]) ~= Spec A times_W Z be an isomorphism whose projection to Spec A is the canonical base tensor map. Let q be the prime of zA under eC. Then A and B=C_q are Noetherian rings, and q contracts along A -> C to the maximal ideal of A. No completion or log regularity hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Choose a Noetherian affine neighbourhood of the image of $\bar w$. Its ordinary local ring is Noetherian by localization. The pointed-neighbourhood/triple comparison and the strict-henselization triple theorem identify $A$ with the algebraic strict henselization of that local ring, for the separable residue closure inside $\Omega$. Thus $A$ is nonzero Noetherian local. Put $C=A\otimes_{\mathbf Z[R]}\mathbf Z[Q]$. A finite generating list $q_1,\ldots,q_d$ of $Q$ gives a surjection $A[x_1,\ldots,x_d]\twoheadrightarrow C$, $x_i\mapsto[q_i]$. Hence $C$, and then $B=C_{\mathfrak q}$, are Noetherian. Since the chosen lift is over the closed point of $\operatorname{Spec}A$, $\mathfrak q\cap A=\mathfrak m_A$. In particular $A\to B$ is local and $B\ne0$. Every generator of $J$ is a nonunit of $B$, so $J\subseteq\mathfrak m_B$. The same finite-generation argument on the chosen affine charts of $W$ shows that $Z$ is locally Noetherian.

Use the equation for eC over A and the closed-point equation for zA to identify the contraction with the kernel of the strict-base evaluation to Omega. Its kernel is the maximal ideal by the canonical strict-local ring construction.
